profile.headline: AI/ML Software Engineer
profile.summary: Experienced Research Assistant with a demonstrated history of working in the higher education industry. Strong programming skills in Python and C++ with exposure to C# and JavaScript. Skilled in working in Microsoft Applications and on Linux servers. Enthusiastic Computer Science Graduate with a Bachelor of Science (B.S.) focused in Computer Science from Sonoma State University.

positions.title: AI Computer Vision Software Engineering Intern
Deep Learning Research Assistant
positions.description: Research on classifying wildlife animals through pre-trained convolutional neural networks and machine learning using numPy and TensorFlow through the Python programming language.

positions.title: Electronics Team Member
positions.description: Worked in a fast-paced environment, learned time management, and solved daily challenges with coworkers and customers.

honors.title: Cyberpatriot - Gold Level
honors.description: Participated in the Cyberpatriot cybersecurity competition and achieved to the regional level in the Gold bracket.
honors.issuer: Issued by The Air Force Association · Jan 2016

volunteerExperiences.description: I had the opportunity to tutor grade school children in Lego NXT Robotic construction and programming. They were taught the fundamentals of how to use logic and critical thinking to solve problem that were presented to them through computer systems and functional building.

volunteerExperiences.companyName: Volunteer Center of the East Bay
volunteerExperiences.description: I joined the Volunteer Center of the East Bay and created a new cybersecurity policy that would allow other nonprofit organizations to keep track of their system security and manage how their software and hardware are updated to prevent any security flaws, loopholes, or risks to the organizations. I directly checked the center's systems and informed them of what they needed to update, and how secure systems can benefit the efficiency and protection of their work.
